studies.name: Budzyń et al. — Endoscopist deskilling risk after exposure to AI in colonoscopy
studies.draft_uses: Published paper Lancet Gastroenterol Hepatol 2025;10(10):896–903, plus its September 2025 correction (doi 10.1016/S2468-1253(25)00294-8). Core figures: ADR 28.4% (226/795) to 22.4% (145/648), −6.0 pp, 95% CI −10.5 to −1.6, P=0.0089 (from Nature Reviews highlight; accepted manuscript gives p=0.009). Also notes correspondence letters in Dec 2025 (Levartovsky, Lam, van de Sande, Authors' reply) but states it could not read them.
studies.latest_known: Published paper and its correction are the latest formal outputs. Four correspondence letters appeared in Lancet Gastroenterol Hepatol 2025;10(12) (December 2025): Lam (p.1060), Levartovsky & Kopylov (pp.1060–1061), van de Sande et al. (pp.1061–1062), and Authors' reply (p.1062). The draft discloses it cannot read the Levartovsky letter and notes a fact-check report that it misdescribes the study's design. No further correction or retraction found as of October 2026.
studies.what_changed: No figures changed. The draft already incorporates the September 2025 correction and discloses the December 2025 correspondence. The core ADR figures (28.4%, 22.4%, −6.0 pp, CI −10.5 to −1.6) are unadjusted and unaffected by the correction. Status is CURRENT on the figures the draft prints.

studies.draft_uses: Described as a 'COLM 2026 conference paper', arXiv:2604.04721. Draft states it checked versions 2 and 4. studies.latest_known: arXiv:2604.04721 was last revised on 13 October 2026 (v6), six days before today's date. The draft checked v4 (last revised 5 August 2026). A v5 (revised 3 October 2026) and v6 (revised 13 October 2026) now exist. Whether the core figures (effect sizes −0.42/−0.19/−0.42, N=1,222/1,060) changed in v5 or v6 cannot be confirmed from search results alone.
studies.what_changed: Two new versions (v5, 3 October 2026; v6, 13 October 2026) have appeared since the draft checked v4 (5 August 2026). The draft's figures were verified against v4. Whether the effect sizes (−0.42, −0.19, −0.42), participant counts (1,222 randomised, 1,060 analysed), or pre-registration status changed in v5 or v6 is unconfirmed. UNKNOWN because the draft explicitly states it checked v4 and v2, but v6 now exists and has not been checked.
